questions.title: UNION ALL Keeps Everything
questions.description: What does UNION ALL guarantee?
questions.Option2: It keeps every row from both selects, duplicates included
questions.Option4: It merges columns side by side

questions.title: Column Count Rule
questions.description: Compound SELECTs (UNION/INTERSECT/EXCEPT) require that each branch:
questions.Option2: Has the same number of columns, aligned positionally
questions.Option4: Returns the same number of rows

questions.Option1: Rows found in both A and B
questions.Option2: Rows in B that are not in A
questions.Option4: Rows in A that are not in B

questions.title: ORDER BY Placement
questions.description: In 'A UNION B ORDER BY x', the ORDER BY clause:
questions.Option2: Is invalid after a compound select
questions.Option3: Sorts the combined result of the whole compound

questions.title: UNION NULL Handling
questions.description: Two rows have NULL in the same column. How does UNION treat them when deduplicating?
questions.Option1: NULLs are treated as equal, so the rows dedupe
questions.Option4: Each NULL is unique and both rows are kept

questions.title: Compound Alias Sorting
questions.description: Which statement about ORDER BY in a compound select is TRUE?
questions.Option1: It must use literal numbers only
questions.Option2: It must repeat inside every branch
questions.Option3: It is applied before the set operation
questions.Option4: It must use column names/aliases from the first SELECT's output

questions.title: Track Count Sanity
questions.description: attendees_2024 has 10 rows, attendees_2025 has 10 rows, with 2 shared (name, company, track) triples and 1 duplicate inside 2025. How many rows does the UNION of the three columns return?

questions.title: UNION Cost
questions.description: Why can UNION ALL be faster than UNION?

questions.title: EXCEPT Alias
questions.description: Which other SQL dialect keyword is equivalent to SQLite's EXCEPT?

questions.title: Compound Alias Snippet
questions.description: Is the ORDER BY in this query valid SQLite?
questions.Option1: No — it must say ORDER BY name
questions.Option2: No — compound queries cannot be sorted
questions.Option3: Yes — it refers to the first SELECT's output column
questions.codesnippet:
SELECT name AS attendee FROM attendees_2024
UNION
SELECT name FROM attendees_2025
ORDER BY attendee;

questions.title: Mismatched Column Count Snippet
questions.description: What happens when this compound SELECT runs?
questions.Option1: It errors — both branches of a set operation must return the same number of columns
questions.Option2: It succeeds — the missing column is filled with NULL
questions.Option3: It succeeds — SQLite returns only the first column of each row
questions.Option4: It succeeds — SQLite matches the columns by name

questions.title: Positional Alignment Snippet
questions.description: What does this INTERSECT actually compare?
questions.Option1: It matches columns positionally, so first-column values are compared with each other regardless of the names
questions.Option2: It matches columns by name, so it swaps automatically
questions.Option3: It joins the two tables on names

questions.title: UNION Dedup Scope
questions.description: UNION removes duplicate rows based on:
questions.Option4: All output columns of the row

questions.title: Chained Set Op Precedence
questions.description: In 'A EXCEPT B UNION C', how does SQLite evaluate the operators?
questions.Option3: INTERSECT binds tighter; UNION and EXCEPT are then evaluated left to right

questions.title: Per Branch Limit Trick
questions.description: How many rows does this query return?
questions.Option4: A syntax error — LIMIT is illegal here
questions.codesnippet:
SELECT name FROM (SELECT name, company
  FROM attendees_2024 LIMIT 3)
UNION ALL
SELECT name FROM (SELECT name, company
  FROM attendees_2025 LIMIT 3);

questions.title: INTERSECT With NULLs
questions.description: Both branches return a row with company = NULL (other columns equal). What does INTERSECT do?
questions.Option2: Matches them — in set operations NULLs compare as equal
questions.Option4: Returns one NULL row per branch

questions.title: Literal Header Snippet
questions.description: What are the column headers of this compound result?
questions.Option3: An error — literals cannot be selected
questions.codesnippet:
SELECT '2024' AS cohort, COUNT(*)
FROM attendees_2024
UNION ALL
SELECT '2025', COUNT(*)
FROM attendees_2025;
